entries.what: A free lifetime America the Beautiful pass covering entrance and standard day-use fees at federal recreation sites. No VA disability rating required, and no closing date.
facts: Veterans of any branch, including National Guard and Reserve, plus Gold Star Family members
National Park Service, Forest Service, Fish & Wildlife Service, Bureau of Land Management, Bureau of Reclamation and Army Corps of Engineers sites
The holder plus occupants of one private non-commercial vehicle, or two motorcycles. Where fees are per person, the holder plus three others aged 16 and over.
Veteran Health Identification Card, the VA's digital Veteran ID Card, DD Form 2, DD Form 2765, Next Generation USID, or a veteran designation on a state driver's licence or ID card
Free in person at many federal recreation sites. Free as a digital pass on Recreation.gov; $7.50 for a physical card posted to you, or $10 by mail from the USGS Store.
A separate free Access Pass exists for any US citizen or resident with a permanent disability, and can discount expanded amenities such as camping and guided tours.
